london_box.source_claim: London-low A1 is a named sequence, not a daily default.

asia_box.source_claim: Asia-high failure short, no TDO required. Histogram must show Asia entries.

asia_tdo_case.source_claim: Literal 5-minute close below TDO after Asia-high sweep.

prior_week_level.source_claim: Previous weekly candle's extremes (PWH/PWL) as sweep-and-reclaim references, both sides, one reference lifecycle per level per week. The page names the level set and dates three uses; it states no frequency, so the bound is the structural one: at most one episode per side per session.

observed_rate_justification.text: The source gives no weekly-level frequency. The episodes-per-session bound [0, 2] is structural (one reference per side per session) and the pass-rate bound reuses the prior_day_level sweep-and-reclaim template on the same confirmation mode. An observed rate outside it is reported, not tuned.

prior_day_level.source_claim: PDL/PDH sweep and 5-minute close. Both sides. Overnight eligible.

nyam_box.source_claim: At-level failure of the 9-10 box and sub-boxes. A+ is one or two per session across boxes, not several nyam passes.

previous_hour.source_claim: Completed-hour fail-back. Repeats allowed. Not several A+ per hour.

nwog.source_claim: NWOG Mondays. Destination after a midnight or NY-open failure, not a daily box.

cash_open_reclaim_case.source_claim: 09:30 manipulation below, reclaim, retracement objective, stops at lows. Confirmation duration unpublished (OD 5-minute reclaim).

golden_pocket.source_claim: Down-leg pocket plus a real failure. Band touch alone is not the setup.

ny_session_extreme.source_claim: One dated afternoon sweep-and-fail of the running NY session low after 11:00, plus the text that session highs and lows are the table edges.
